name: ddd-clean-migration
description: Reusable Codex workflow for broad-to-specific legacy-to-DDD/Clean Architecture migration with guided per-bounded-context discovery delegation, planning, and safe-area scaffolding.

interface.shortDescription: Codex workflow for guided broad-to-specific legacy-to-DDD migration.
interface.longDescription: A Codex plugin with reusable skills, agents, templates, and scripts for broad discovery, optional per-bounded-context deep-discovery delegation, bounded-context design, migration-slice planning, and safe-area implementation toward DDD and Clean Architecture.
defaultPrompt: Map candidate bounded contexts and relations from this legacy repository, then decide whether per-BC deep discovery should be delegated.
Design a DDD migration for this bounded context.
Scaffold a safe-area migration workspace and implement one approved slice.
